items.html: And afterward the three worlds Beriah, Yetzirah, Assiyah were corrected, and still all the Klipot were without any correction at all. However, the Klipot were still in the manner that holiness was at first, before the correction. And then ZA and the Nukva of the Klipa of Atzilut were six lights in the male alone, in the secret of VAK, and only one light, the seventh, in the Nukva, like the aspect of ZA and the Nukva of holiness when they are back-to-back. And this is the matter of that minute illumination that is within the impurity, mentioned in Parashat Yitro, in the Sitrei Torah.
